== English errata comparison sources ==
Decipher changed the timing to a just-ended battle and removed the post-forfeiting clause. The relocation and Weather Vane option are unchanged. The later PC release reproduces Decipher’s version.

Decipher, updated 29 January 2002, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=7 Glossary Supplement], PDF page 7. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=11 Decipher Errata], PDF page 11. Players Committee, Appendix A, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=127 2023 Advanced Rulebook], PDF page 127.
